adds — treating "$65.00, 50+15." as the answer
wrong rate — treating "$3.50, 50*0.07." as the answer

questions.stem: Interest $60 on $1000 for 2 years; explain rate.
questions.explanation: The rule that settles this simple interest on a principal item is: Divide interest by P*t. That is why "Rate = interest/(principal*time) = 60/(1000*2) = 0" is the answer.
